slides.title: Evidence before the estimate
key_points: Offline, synthetic, independent
300 files, 8 features, 126 evidence, 24 findings, 12 dispositions
9 seed audit events; 11 after Accept M-01 + Reject M-12
Not affiliated with Guidewire; official Cloud Assurance not run

slides.title: A migration estimate is a promise. The inventory is the proof.
key_points: Four questions: what exists, which feature, what is disposed, what is unknown/owner
Softened scope wording: files that were never classified
APD limits type names to 24 characters; endpoint generation then fails to compile; nameOverride is the documented correction
Other APD short-name/label limits exist (for example 22/30 characters)
JDBC/commits/servlets/hidden packages often surface in CUE or a build gate; earlier discovery limits estimate movement
6–8 weeks is a vendor APD-conversion estimate, not a full migration estimate
SBT lines cannot convert: readiness scope/estimate risk
Incomplete handover (premise, not measured)

slides.title: No public tool we found combines PCF/entity/typelist/template/Gosu evidence into one disposition + assumption packet
key_points: Explicitly acknowledged: Guidewire CUE, Cloud Assurance Services, Lighthouse, SurePath, Developer Assistants, GoQu, CAST/ADDI (portfolio and code discovery), Syntra ETL (data migration/extraction), SI assessments
Gap = cross-artefact feature evidence + disposition ledger + assumption register + packet
Positioning, not an independent product evaluation

slides.title: One pipeline. Nine stages. Every step leaves a trace.
key_points: Snapshot → intake/hash → parse → discover → review → reconstruct → compare → evaluate → packet
Read-only; unsupported listed; every claim evidence; every change pending; no LLM/external calls
300 → 126 evidence → 24 findings → 12 dispositions → 1 packet

slides.title: A claim is only as strong as its locator, its label, and its open question.
key_points: Claim fields: path, locator, excerpt, excerpt_sha, method, confidence
Claim strength: verified-id, verified-policy, verified-doc, secondary, heuristic
Assumption fields: ID, statement, owner, impact range, question, status
Packet hash covers rendered HTML; packet_json covers canonical JSON; content digests bind findings/mappings/evidence; audit head covers the chain
Tamper-evident, not non-repudiation

slides.title: One feature, traced across six artefact families.
key_points: 31 evidence / 12 files / 4 artefact types / 2 tests / 11 PA-VEH-01 references
37 vs 24 APD type-name limit; long type is in 2 files and is a PA-VEH-02 dependency, not one of the 11 references
3 estate-wide gaps
18-node spine; click node → EV-0001
Fixture realism: 300 files include generated filler; PCF/product model/Gosu are synthetic sketches, not production Guidewire formats

slides.title: No silent omission. Four files are excluded — and named.
key_points: 300 files hashed
4 excluded: 2 binary, 1 corrupt, 1 unsupported
Source hash unchanged bd4a8a4b338a before/after; visible value matches the live immutability banner
Excluded files stay in the packet
Fixture realism: generated filler and synthetic parser-boundary examples; not a production Guidewire export

slides.title: A decision queue, not a rename script.
key_points: 12 dispositions / 5 target changes (C-01…C-05)
Four exact documented examples + one documented 24-char mechanism applied to a synthetic long type + 6 API conventions + 1 typelist convention
Accept M-01; reject M-12 (R-TYP-01) → A-DEC-04
_gen writes: 0; draft local/non-deployable
Scope: Cloud Retrofit without APD App; field-level nameOverride only on that path; _ext is a local JSON contract, not official Guidewire schema/mapping/updater syntax

slides.title: Precision is a feature. Restraint is the interface.
key_points: 24 findings / 8 rules; F-001 SBT readiness flag separate; F-002…F-025 advisory findings
Claim strength: 12 verified-id, 3 verified-policy, 3 verified-doc, 3 secondary, 3 heuristic
Two standard families: Cloud Standards IS-TLS-1238 / IS-TLS-1191; Gosu Secure Coding SEC00-G / ERR00-G
Precision guards: 8 rules × 3 hard negatives; Query.make supported; 24/24 silent
No Cloud Assurance pass/fail or violation claim

slides.title: It would rather refuse than invent a source.
key_points: Territory refusal names missing evidence
Motorcycle_Ext cites EV-0023, VehicleType.ttx, xpath, line 3
Retrieval-only, model off
Citations resolve to evidence records

slides.title: Perfect scores measure the instrument. The estate is still unproven.
key_points: Six headline metrics: M1 8/8, M2 8/8, M3 101/101 + 30/30, M4 12/12, M5 6/6 with 6/8 allowance, M6 F1 1.00 (24 TP / 0 FP / 0 FN)
24/24 hard negatives silent = separate guard count, not a seventh metric
Holdout 4/4, 51.0–100.0, not imported
In-sample; no human IAA; reference internally authored; support ≠ entailment

slides.title: The review artifact is the product.
key_points: 6 sections
126 evidence items
Post-decision: 11 audit events / 4 assumptions / A-DEC-04
Pre-decision: 9 events / 3 assumptions; label pre-decision captures
Packet, packet_json, and audit-head values are read live; they change with reviewer actions and packet refresh
Packet hash covers rendered HTML; packet_json covers canonical JSON; content digests bind findings/mappings/evidence; audit head covers the chain
Two-step verification: verify-packet checks the packet and content digests; verify-audit checks the audit chain only, not the packet
Crop shows the assumption-register summary (A-01); live register has four rows including A-DEC-04
Downloadable HTML; local, not certification

slides.title: Five agents. One evidence chain. No authority to deploy.
key_points: Straight handoff chain: Scout → Architect → Guardian → Critic → Scribe; the cyclic rework loop is the codebase lab
R-DEMO-001: 300 files, 101 evidence records, 31 links on PA-VEH-01, 24 findings, 12 dispositions
5 work packages, 5 target files, 11 gates (3 assumptions + 8 rule groups, 6 high), 7/7 checks, 8 listed files
completed_with_gates; no deployment, no tenant contact, no Gosu/Java compile against Guidewire, no official Cloud Assurance
Optional live reasoning run R-20261111-052740-b001: 3 citation-checked calls, 0 ungrounded claims, Guardian 0 model calls; deterministic 7/7 unchanged
Reality boundary callout: synthetic rehearsal, not an actual migration

slides.title: Scout hands over 31 links and 12 dispositions. Architect writes five files.
key_points: Scout: 300 files, 101 evidence records, 31 links on PA-VEH-01, 24 findings, 12 dispositions, snapshot bd4a8a4b338a
Five work packages and bytes: schema 945 B, mapping 3,046 B, updater 402 B, codegen 520 B, API 78 B
WP-01 PAVehicle→PersonalVehicle; WP-02 PAVehicle.Year→ModelYear; WP-03 PADriver→VehicleDriver; WP-04 PALine→PersonalAutoLine; WP-05 long APD type
WP-05 carries G-03 at handoff; all five packages draft_ready, mapped_transformed, and pending
_gen targets 0, duplicate targets 0, auto-approved changes 0
Five target files are not five deployment units; WP-02 mapping carries all 12 dispositions

slides.title: Guardian turns 24 findings and 3 assumptions into 11 human gates.
key_points: 24 findings → 8 rule groups × 3 = 24; 3 assumptions; 11 human gates; 6 high impact; 0 resolved
Assumption gates G-01, G-02, G-03 are unassigned; G-01 and G-03 high, G-02 medium
Rule groups G-04…G-11 each carry 3 findings; high: NAM, PKG, SEC, SQL; medium: EXC, GUNIT, SRV, TX
Guardian deliberately does not receive Scout’s narrative, Critic’s verdict, or model-generated text
A gate is a named human decision with an owner; open is a status, not a scoring failure

slides.title: Critic passes 7/7. Scribe seals 8 listed files. Neither approves.
key_points: Critic 7/7 package-integrity checks: packages exist; 5/5 generated; no _gen; 5 unique targets; 5 files parse; 5/5 evidence-linked; 0 auto-approved
Scribe seals 8 listed files = 5 target drafts + plan + report + 12-event log; bundle-manifest.json is the wrapper
Seal hash prefixes: plan 3c307f75205c, report 8770963bd2fd, bundle 6c5b7f5a5aec, agent log 5c28ba80c3f75eb6
Review packet audit: 9 seed events, 11 after the two runbook decisions; migrator log: 12 events, separate hash chain
Sealed means tamper-evident, not approved; completed_with_gates, 11 gates open, 0 auto-approved

slides.title: Two synthetic insurers, two migration shapes, one bounded crew.
key_points: Cascade: 18 findings (10 error / 8 warning), 22 patches, 2 iterations, 10 human gates; 13 rules fired
Harbor: 20 findings (11 error / 9 warning), 21 patches, 2 iterations, 11 human gates; 15 rules fired
Illustrative synthetic footprints: Cascade 420,000 policies / 38 PCF screens / 64 custom Gosu files / 7 integrations; Harbor 2.6M / 214 / 1,180 / 42
Both green_with_human_gates; structural 100/100; human-gate-adjusted 74 (Cascade) and 71 (Harbor)
Qusar 2026.08 snapshots → simulated GWCP 2027.04 target; same 16-family rule pack; SARIF 2.1.0; every patch pending
Harbor APD is type-level APN naming preparation only, not full APD conversion or field mapping

slides.title: The code lab closes the loop — and still leaves 10/11 human gates.
key_points: 16 code rule families; Cascade 18 findings / 22 patches / 10 gates / 13 SARIF rules; Harbor 20 / 21 / 11 / 15
SARIF 2.1.0, tool driver PreFlight CodeGuard; official_cloud_assurance false; synthetic true; no source excerpts or secret values
Before: JDBC/DriverManager + concatenated SQL in VehicleRatingQuery.gs; after: generated Gosu Query draft using Query.make(...).select()
The draft is not compiled; semantic equivalence, field mapping, and runtime behavior remain human gates
CDA is streaming/export to S3 Parquet, not a synchronous in-app read; synchronous reads use Gosu Query or an application API
Custom servlets are “not a recommended practice,” not “unsupported”

slides.title: A green signal is release-bound, not permanent.
key_points: Five simulated GWCP 2026.10 → 2027.04 scenarios; not published 2027.04 release notes
APD 24 → 20 characters is a simulation; generation 1 → 2; prior green signal invalidated
Exposure counts (Cascade/Harbor): APD 2/2, App Events v2 3/3, Gateway mTLS 7/6, removed Gosu API 14/14, Cloud API version 4/3
Resume options: revalidate → resume_requested; rollback → rolled_back_to_checkpoint; defer → upgrade_deferred; all clear green and keep human approval
APD regenerated at 20 characters → compatible; 24-character bundle → revalidation_required
Named unexpected states: source changed, corrupt file, duplicate target, analyzer crash, empty snapshot; counts are exposure, not effort

slides.title: The demo is the surface. The hardening is the work.
key_points: 481 tests passed
1 Playwright golden path
18/18 recorded freeze hashes recompute
0 raw secret values in artifacts
9 seed audit events verified; 11 after the two runbook actions
12/12 concurrent accepts persist; forged evidence 0/48; packet 126 items

slides.title: The algorithms are not new. The integration and the evidence discipline are the contribution.
key_points: Feature location, traceability, architecture conformance, GSN are established
Reversa 2026 is closest prior art
Integration + domain evidence model is the contribution
No first/only claim

slides.title: The wedge is real. The evidence is not yet sufficient to call it a product.
key_points: Synthetic in-sample; internally authored target; no human IAA
No real estate; CUE is the official Cloud Upgrade Estimate; Cloud Assurance Services/Lighthouse own the official gate and migration lab
Vendor-independent wedge, not independently validated
Roadmap: real estate, second LOB, blind annotation, line-level, performance, import/export, compile validation

key_points: Ask: one authorised estate, two blind SME annotators, hard feedback
